definitions.explanation: People who take a hobby, game, or interest very seriously and put in significant time, effort, and often money. Contrasted with casual participants ({エンジョイ勢|えんじょいぜい}).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ガチ{勢|ぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: This game has a lot of hardcore players, so ranking high is tough.

examples.japanese: ガチ{勢|ぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I'm not a hardcore player, but I enjoy the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガチ{勢|ぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全|ぜん}⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Hardcore idol fans attend every concert.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ガチ (from ガチガチ/ガチンコ meaning "serious, for real") + {勢|ぜい} (group, faction). The suffix {勢|ぜい} is used to categorize groups of people in gaming and fan communities.

REGISTER: Casual/Slang
Used primarily in gaming, otaku, and fan communities. Has spread to general youth language.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・Gaming: players who optimize strategies and equipment
・Idol fandom: fans who attend all events and buy all merchandise
・Hobbies: enthusiasts who invest heavily in their interests

CONTRAST:
・ガチ{勢|ぜい}: serious/hardcore participants
・⟦エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}→エンジョイ勢：29810_enjoizei⟧: casual participants who play for fun
・⟦にわか→俄：00321_niwaka⟧: newcomer, bandwagoner (sometimes pejorative)

OTHER ～{勢|ぜい} TERMS:
・⟦エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}→エンジョイ勢：29810_enjoizei⟧: casual players
・⟦{無|む}{課金|かきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧{勢|ぜい}: free-to-play players
・{微|び}⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧{勢|ぜい}: light spenders
・⟦{重課金|じゅうかきん}{勢|ぜい}→重課金勢：29811_juukakinzei⟧: heavy spenders
